issue.title: Nested plans checkout is treated as a project root and keeps syncing recursively

task_type_fields.impact: The extra clone receives unexpected Git writes and can be rebased or refreshed by processes that resolve it as a project root.
task_type_fields.repro: The approved plan records that this nested clone was fetched and rebased at 2026-11-14 06:53 even though the plans repo ignores /sase/repos/. Inspect its reflog and the root-resolution coverage in tests/sdd_store/test_nested_repo_open_sdd_root.py.

issue.creation_reason: The approved crash-repair investigation found fetch and rebase activity in an ignored nested plans clone. Tracking its root-resolution defect separately prevents this unrelated issue from being hidden by the crash-repair implementation.

payload.description: Both involve unexpected activity or state in a plans sidecar clone; this task is about recursive root resolution, while sase-10y addressed a dirty hidden-clone write lane.
